items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As far as I know, I recorded it for Gus Deterris, for a label called…

ctx.x: Another gentleman who had a label was Gus DeTerris. And he brought, either he brought, or Eddie Bert somehow found you, that was one of the early recordings.
Yeah, I wasn’t partied to that, you understand, I wasn’t present as to who said what to whom. As far as I know, I recorded it for Gus Deterris, for a label called…
Well, yeah it was called Progressive.
